context.description: Step 01: Design the named role registry for IDN-05. IDN-05 adds a per-tenant registry that maps named business roles (distinct from IDN-03 platform RBAC roles) to groups. A HUMAN_TASK node's assignee_ref for assignee_type=ROLE names a role in this registry. At task activation (EE-03), the platform resolves the named role to its bound group and creates the Task with GROUP semantics.
artifacts_in: src/design/ (check for related designs: IDN-02, IDN-03, EE-03)

task.description:
Produce a design artefact for IDN-05 (Named role registry and ROLE assignee resolution). Write the design to src/design/idn05-role-registry.md. The design must cover all acceptance criteria:

1. Data model: a new table `tenant_role` (columns: id UUID PK, tenant_id, name TEXT, group_id UUID FK→groups, created_at) scoped per tenant. The same role name may exist with different group_ids in different tenants.
2. API surface:
   - GET /roles — list role bindings for calling tenant (requires PROCESS_DESIGNER or PLATFORM_ADMIN)
   - POST /roles — create or update a binding { name, group_id }; returns HTTP 404 if group_id does not exist in the tenant
3. EE-03 integration: when a HUMAN_TASK node with assignee_type=ROLE activates, look up the role name in tenant_role. If found, create Task with group_id semantics (any ACTIVE member may claim/complete). If NOT found, create Task in PENDING status (no error — mirrors the 'group with no members' edge case).
4. Migration: a new numbered migration file adding the tenant_role table.
5. Classify per templates/lego-catalog.md and justify the classification.
6. Cover edge cases: re-binding a role name does not affect existing PENDING tasks; role names are fully scoped per tenant.

The design MUST NOT contain implementation code (Zig source). It MUST be complete enough for BACKEND-DEV and FRONTEND-DEV to proceed without ambiguity.
